title: Serverless RAG Quickstart
description: Template schema for deploying a zero-idle-cost, serverless RAG application on Google Cloud using Cloud Run and Vertex AI RAG Engine.

display_name.description: Display name prefix for quickstart resources.

container_image.description: Container image URI for the FastAPI RAG microservice.

min_instances.description: Minimum Cloud Run instances (0 enables serverless scale-to-zero).

max_instances.description: Maximum Cloud Run instances for autoscaling.

allow_unauthenticated.description: Whether to permit public unauthenticated invocations.
